changelog: Single proven libVLC engine (org.videolan.android:libvlc-all:3.6.2) for ALL channels
Instant playback on stubborn streams (including alixbd) with :network-caching=1500 & :http-reconnect
Streaming relay in-app local proxy (127.0.0.1) with real-time chunk flushing
Fullscreen edge-to-edge crop-to-fill (SURFACE_FILL) with zero black bars
Smart route memory + resume on last played channel
Original glowing TV loading animation preserved
4-stage failover: Direct -> Backup -> In-App Local Proxy
Refined live TV player interface and responsive notice ticker
Updated Android TV app package for v3.2.0
updateMessage: v3.2.0 আপডেট: উন্নত UI এবং ইনস্ট্যান্ট লাইভ চ্যানেল প্লেব্যাক।
